DLC2312:4:t_002:8.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「I said, which is it?!」

DLC2312:4:t_002:10.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「What's wrong, woman?! What happened?!」

DLC2312:4:t_002:11.en:
$$中原$$
「A suspicious group of men dressed all in black went into that building!」

DLC2312:4:t_002:13.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「I-it's all right! We're here to protect you!」

DLC2312:4:t_002:14.en:
$$大山$$
「That's rich, coming from the people who kidnapped us!」

DLC2312:4:t_002:15.en:
$$市民$$
「She's right! You forced us to live in this town!」

DLC2312:4:t_002:16.en:
$$市民$$
「That's right! Let us go home!」

DLC2312:4:t_003:2.en:
$$伊集院$$
「It's terrorism! A riot! A coup!!」

DLC2312:4:t_003:3.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Damn it, get out of the way! We can't get through this wall of people!!」

DLC2312:4:t_003:4.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Headquarters, please respond! This is Area C12! Please respond!」

DLC2312:4:t_003:5.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「What's going on?! Communications are down!」

DLC2312:4:t_003:6.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「We've got no choice! We'll fire warning shots to get things under...」

DLC2312:4:t_004:1.en:
$$市民$$
「You bastard! You used your guns!!」

DLC2312:4:t_004:2.en:
$$市民$$
「We won't put up with this anymore!」

DLC2312:4:t_004:3.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「S-stop it, all of you! Resist and we'll shoot!!」

DLC2312:4:t_004:4.en:
$$市民$$
「Go ahead and try! But you'd better be ready for what happens to you!」

DLC2312:4:t_005:0.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「R-reporting, sir! Riots have broken out all over town!」

DLC2312:4:t_005:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I sincerely hope our soldiers haven't opened fire.」

DLC2312:4:t_005:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear... I told you beforehand that was the one thing you mustn't do...」

DLC2312:4:t_005:4.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「B-but they're prisoners! Surely we should control them through violence and fear...」

DLC2312:4:t_005:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You must have sensed it yourself by now. That reasoning doesn't work on this planet.」

DLC2312:4:t_005:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Once a fire is lit under Earthlings, they won't stop. That's just how this planet's people are.」

DLC2312:4:t_005:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「They've completely outplayed us... Apparently, some truly first-rate operatives slipped past our security and infiltrated the town.」

DLC2312:4:t_005:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It can't be helped. Let's deploy those useless $$デイモーン$$s.」

DLC2312:4:t_006:0.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The $$デイモーン$$s are moving!」

DLC2312:4:t_006:1.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「We're counting on you two!」

DLC2312:4:t_007:0.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Amazing! They took them out in an instant!」

DLC2312:4:t_007:1.en:
$$レイカ$$
「How did you manage to bring weapons in under security this tight?」

DLC2312:4:t_007:3.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「Such things are simply part of a butler's repertoire.」

DLC2312:4:t_007:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「This isn't good. In that case, the next thing to happen will be...」

DLC2312:4:t_008:0.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「The residents are escaping from town amid the confusion.」

DLC2312:4:t_008:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Section Chief $$大杉$$, report from the scene. How are things going?」

DLC2312:4:t_008:2.en:
$$大杉$$
「Everything is proceeding smoothly. Following $$ルゥ$$'s behavioral analysis, $$２１世紀警備保障$$ is directing the residents' evacuation.」

DLC2312:4:t_008:3.en:
$$横沢$$
「The members of Team M have joined us, too.」

DLC2312:4:t_008:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$佐伯$$'s operation was a resounding success.」

DLC2312:4:t_008:5.en:
$$佐伯$$
「We thought a situation like this might arise, so under Section Chief $$大杉$$, the support and maintenance crews have both undergone basic training.」

DLC2312:4:t_008:6.en:
$$田中司令$$
「That depth of talent is what makes $c strong.」

DLC2312:4:t_009:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「You've finally shown yourself, $$サルディアス$$!」

DLC2312:4:t_009:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Now we just have to beat you, and it's over!」

DLC2312:4:t_009:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Getting operatives through security this tight, and then organizing an evacuation... Is there any limit to your efficiency?」

DLC2312:4:t_009:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Of course we pulled it off! We used $c's secret weapon!」

DLC2312:4:t_009:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「From here on, we use force. Are you ready, $$サルディアス$$?」

DLC2312:4:t_009:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And you will tell us about $$バルビエル$$'s plans...」

DLC2312:4:t_009:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My special charm is that I'm too stubborn to simply say, yes, of course, at a time like this.」

DLC2312:4:t_009:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I may be out of clever plans, but I'll finish this on sheer guts!」

DLC2312:4:t_009:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ah! That's the one thing you mustn't call me!」

DLC2312:4:t_010:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Whoa! Is this as far as I go?!」

DLC2312:4:t_010:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My, my... Atoning with my life for losing the base... really isn't my style.」

DLC2312:4:t_010:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「For now, I'll pay the price for my defeat.」

DLC2312:4:t_010:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Your beloved $$スズネ$$ has been received as a valued guest of our boss... or rather, of $$サイデリアル$$.」

DLC2312:4:t_010:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Don't worry. When the time comes, the boss will bring her to you. And I'm sure that time isn't far off.」

DLC2312:4:t_010:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And with that, poof!」

DLC2312:4:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't pursue him too far, $n. We've got the essential information.」

DLC2312:4:t_011:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「First, let's secure $$ターミナル・ベース$$ and protect the residents.」

DLC2312:4:t_011:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The resistance will be coming, too. We can leave things in their hands after that.」

DLC2312:4:t_011:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Yes. Then let's return and show our appreciation to the people who earned today's special honors.」

review.context: The support crew stages theft alarms and panic, turning residents against the occupiers. The butlers disable robots, the population escapes and the mobile force defeats Sardias.
decisions: Nono's Saru nickname is rendered Mr. Monkey to retain the Japanese monkey insult that triggers Sardias' reaction.
The left/right answers remain deliberate one-word replies amid the diversion.
The apparent gunshot victim is part of the staged panic; no actual death is inserted.
